rationale: The original short thesis relied on price rejecting the 5-minute 9-EMA, but RELY has since reclaimed and held above the 9-EMA ($21.26) to trade at $21.40 alongside a broader market bounce (SPY recovering from -3.55% to -2.94%). With the immediate technical resistance broken and price pressing toward the $21.48 invalidation level, exiting now preserves capital rather than waiting for the hard stop. Flipping to long is not warranted given the wide 18.7 bps spread, heavy gap-down weakness, and overhead session VWAP at $21.98.
